pages.title: Zombie Hill Racing
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Zombie Hill Racing is a driving progression game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Take the selected car through a series of levels and upgrade it so it can complete the routes ahead. Vehicle improvement is a central part of advancing through the campaign.

The game has twelve stages, each containing three levels. Reaching another stage introduces a new car to drive and develop. Your objective is to complete the current set of routes, strengthen the vehicle when needed, and work through the full collection of stages and cars.

pages.title: Crunch Lock Jam
pages.creator: Individual
pages.description: Turn interlocking tools in the correct order in Crunch Lock Jam. Check which wrench has space to move before rotating it around its screw. Free the blocked pieces step by step until the whole arrangement can be cleared.

pages.title: Scale The Depths
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Catch sea life in Scale The Depths. Lower the hook, reel in a fish and use the catch in the game's feeding cycle. Explore farther into the quiet ocean to discover different creatures along the route.

pages.title: SpelunKing
pages.creator: Mad Data
pages.description: Match gems deep underground in SpelunKing. Search for lost items belonging to your grandfather and collect stones for the people rebuilding Farnsbury. Use progress from the puzzles to improve buildings and unlock more of the town's facilities.

pages.title: Food Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Send dishes to matching colored tables in Food Sort Puzzle. Use the four spare slots to hold pieces that cannot go straight to their destination. Plan the order carefully so the temporary spaces stay available for the remaining plates.

pages.title: Doodle Dino Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Guide a dinosaur through a hand-drawn running course in Doodle Dino Run. Time jumps to clear hazards before they reach the character. Keep the run going to push your distance record farther.

pages.title: Cupid’s Story: Love Archer Bow
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Aim love arrows at characters in Cupid’s Story: Love Archer Bow. Choose the hearts you want to connect and watch the pairings created by each shot. Experiment with different matches as the romantic puzzles change.

pages.title: Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Remove direction-marked cubes in Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D. Rotate the structure to see which blocks have a clear exit and tap those first. Use the open space to release pieces that were trapped behind them.

pages.title: Urus City Driver
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Take an upgraded sports SUV around town in Urus City Driver. Complete driving challenges with your dog, use nitro to pass slower vehicles and customize the car's performance or appearance. Explore the morning city map between missions.

pages.title: Magic Sort
pages.creator: QiGame
pages.description: Pour colored layers into separate bottles in Magic Sort. Transfer a top layer only when it matches the destination or the bottle is empty. Complete the sorting puzzles as the cat-cafe setting develops around you.

pages.title: Shanghai Town
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Clear matching tiles to earn architecture in Shanghai Town. Remove identical available pairs until each arrangement is gone. Add the resulting buildings to your collection and use them to create a growing city.

pages.title: Labuba Halloween Infestation
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Fight Halloween invaders in Labuba Halloween Infestation. Move with WASD or the arrow keys and aim at the monsters before firing. Try three modes as the enemies become tougher and more dangerous.

pages.title: Car Parking Master 3D – Real Driving Simulator
pages.creator: Zoomie Games
pages.description: Guide cars through tight routes in Car Parking Master 3D – Real Driving Simulator. Leave room at corners and steer around obstacles before lining up with the space. Complete increasingly demanding levels by bringing the vehicle fully into position.

pages.title: Zero to Millionaire!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Build a new life in Zero to Millionaire! Start with simple jobs, improve skills and reinvest your earnings in businesses or better housing. Make choices about clothes, cars and relationships as the character works toward wealth.

pages.title: Animal in Rails!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Rearrange track connections in Animal in Rails! Link wagons to the locomotive and direct each animal toward its destination. Install or remove rails in an order that keeps the trains moving without collisions.

pages.title: Crown & Cannon
pages.creator: Yawning Wolf Studio
pages.description: Expand territory and deploy weapons in Crown & Cannon. Plan attacks against the computer on ground that can be damaged during the battle. Upgrade units and adapt the next deployment to the gaps left in the terrain.

pages.title: Ship Parking Game
pages.creator: dotplay gmbh
pages.description: Organize a boarding queue in Ship Parking Game. Match passengers to their color-patterned seats while keeping the waiting area from jamming. Choose departures that leave enough room for the next group to reach its ship.

pages.title: Doggo Jump
pages.creator: Digital Will Inc.
pages.description: Tap to leap between platforms in Doggo Jump. Pick up bones along the route and choose the moment that gives the puppy a safe landing. Keep hopping to extend the score before a missed jump ends the attempt.

pages.title: Texas Holdem Poker
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Build a hand and make wagers in Texas Holdem Poker. Compare your cards with the community cards while considering the other players' bets. Try different difficulty levels and table rules as you decide when to call, raise or fold.

pages.title: Plant Girl Defense Zombie
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Stop incoming attackers in Plant Girl Defense Zombie. Change firing lanes and select upgrades when the character levels up, using the shooting skills against the next group. Clear twenty-four stages while defending against the advancing undead.

pages.title: Leap of Life
pages.creator: Fast Games
pages.description: Spend a limited supply of jumps carefully in Leap of Life. Walk where you can and use a leap only when it is needed to pass a gap or obstacle. Find the shortest safe route before the remaining lives run out.

pages.title: Celebrity Face Dance
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style one of three stars in Celebrity Face Dance. Apply makeup that suits the character, then continue into the dancing part of the activity. Try the other celebrities to create different combinations of appearance and performance.

pages.title: Street Racing: Moto Drift
pages.creator: Eccentric Games Studio
pages.description: Ride through street races and chases in Street Racing: Moto Drift. Control the bike through sliding turns and use the road ahead to get clear of the police. Keep up the pace as you compete for the win.

pages.title: Maya
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Fire colored balls into the moving chain in Maya. Connect at least three of the same color to remove them before they reach the end of the path. Read the gaps and choose useful colors as you travel through ancient temples.

pages.title: Break n Bounce
pages.creator: Bonanza Games LLC
pages.description: Bounce shots through a field of targets in Break n Bounce. Hold to set the aim, then release a stream of balls at the enemies and bosses. Clear the board in each of the many stages while building a higher score.

pages.title: Heroball SuperHero
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Save a rounded world from square-shaped enemies in Heroball SuperHero. Roll and jump through the adventure, defeat the minions and gather stars. Use your progress to unlock more heroic characters for later levels.

pages.title: Zombie Monster Truck
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Drive through twelve sets of post-apocalyptic stages in Zombie Monster Truck. Earn coins from each attempt and keep improving the current vehicle so it can finish the three levels in a set. Unlock another car when a new stage opens.

pages.title: Crazy 2 Player Moto Racing
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Race over ramps, containers and pipes in Crazy 2 Player Moto Racing. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys and use nitro to gain speed on clear stretches. Challenge the computer or share the course with a second rider.

pages.title: Beauty Party Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Collect waiting passengers along the route in Beauty Party Rush. Steer the sports car away from pillars and spinning gears that can knock riders out. Carry the largest group you can through to the finish.

pages.title: Reach 100 Colors Game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Combine moving values into exact hundreds in Reach 100 Colors Game. Slide shapes horizontally or vertically to bring numbers together. A completed hundred freezes in place, so account for its position while finishing the remaining sums.

pages.title: HEX !
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Fit clusters into a honeycomb grid in HEX ! Complete full lines to clear tiles and create room for another shape. Look at the gaps left after each placement to keep the board usable.

pages.title: Impostor RocketMan
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Launch a small astronaut from a cannon in Impostor RocketMan. Time the starting shot and gather helpful items while the character travels through the course. Try to carry the flight farther than your previous attempt.

pages.title: PlanetUp
pages.creator: mixon.games
pages.description: Clear asteroids from an advancing world's route in PlanetUp. Move the cursor to protect the planet as it crosses space, then collect upgrades along the way. Work toward unlocking the full collection of ninety planets.

pages.title: Bunny Cakes
pages.creator: funky forest
pages.description: Bake a carrot cake shaped like an animal in Bunny Cakes. Follow the recipe to prepare the mixture and continue through the kitchen steps. Finish decorating the bunny once the cake is ready.

pages.title: Sumz!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Rotate numbered blocks to reach the requested total in Sumz! Make the sum horizontally or vertically to clear spheres from the board. Check the new target at each level before arranging the next set of digits.

pages.title: Real Snakes
pages.creator: Fun Plus Studios
pages.description: Guide a growing serpent toward food in Real Snakes. Turn early enough to keep the head away from the body as the creature gets longer. Leave a clear route to the next meal instead of closing yourself into a corner.

pages.title: 4096 3D
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Aim numbered cubes across a three-dimensional board in 4096 3D. Slide to set a position, then shoot a cube toward matching values. Use the resulting merges to build larger numbers while keeping room for the next shot.

pages.title: Ring
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Move a hoop along a thread in Ring without letting its edges touch. Watch changes in the thread's height and adjust before it passes through the opening. Keep the ring centered as the route becomes harder to follow.

pages.title: FNF Music 3D
pages.creator: GM Media
pages.description: Match beats in musical contests in FNF Music 3D. Follow the note cues through groups of songs while the protagonist challenges his girlfriend's father. Keep the timing accurate as you work through the different weeks.

pages.title: The Power Of Math
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Use arithmetic to fight an ogre in The Power Of Math. Choose a hero, solve each question and turn correct answers into attacks. Keep calculating to build enough strength to defeat the monster.

pages.title: Gangster War
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Protect your territory in Gangster War. Shoot the invading gang members and spend earned coins on a stronger defensive position or better weapons. Try six upgradeable guns as you face the next attack.

pages.title: Ringo Starfish
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Explore a hidden island in Ringo Starfish. Gather its crystals while using the character's swimming, firepower and brief invincibility to deal with enemies and traps. Search the territory for the treasures Ringo suspects are concealed there.

pages.title: Flying Cars Era
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Drive or take to the sky in Flying Cars Era. Try Free Drive, Challenge and Race modes, with one- and two-player options available throughout. Explore how the five vehicles handle as you move between roads and flight.

pages.title: Doodieman Bazooka
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Aim sticky projectiles at the targets in Doodieman Bazooka. Look at the obstacles in each scene before choosing the trajectory for a shot. Clear the enemies to move on to another comic shooting puzzle.

pages.title: Siren Apocalyptic
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Scout a radiation-stricken island as an agent in Siren Apocalyptic. Install surveillance cameras to help investigate the monsters there, then search for the towering siren-headed creature. Stay alive while fighting the threats blocking the mission.

pages.title: Filled Glass 2 No Gravity
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Send colored balls upward in Filled Glass 2 No Gravity. Click inside the red launch area to feed the inverted container and watch the level against the dotted mark. Stop at the right amount to complete the fill.

pages.title: Blocky Swat Shooting IceWorld Multiplayer
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Fight online in Blocky Swat Shooting IceWorld Multiplayer. Choose from nine guns and their attachments, then use the icy pixel map to approach opposing players. Keep checking the open angles around your position before firing.

pages.title: Cat Hair Salon
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Wash and restyle animals in Cat Hair Salon. Cut, curl or color their coats, then choose clothing and accessories for the finished looks. Join the cats' birthday celebration for cake, gifts and other activities after their salon visits.

pages.title: Escape Mystery Room
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Find a way out of a locked house in Escape Mystery Room. Inspect the surroundings for objects that help solve the indoor puzzles, then continue the mission outside. Keep your movement quiet to avoid the robots guarding the area.

pages.title: English Grammar Jul Quiz
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Answer language questions in English Grammar Jul Quiz. Choose among three difficulty settings and select the response that fits each sentence. Keep track of the points earned as you work through the test.

pages.title: Soda Can Knockout
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Throw balls into stacks of containers in Soda Can Knockout. Aim at useful points in each arrangement to bring the cans down with the available shots. Clear a level cleanly to work toward its three-star result.

pages.title: Soldiers Fury
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Fight successive attacks in Soldiers Fury. Move through the battlefield while gathering weapons and power-ups, then use the surroundings to damage clustered enemies. Upgrade the arsenal as stronger waves enter the mission.

pages.title: Shape Change
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Change a moving object to fit the openings in Shape Change. Steer with A and D or the arrow keys and read the outline ahead before reaching it. Match the shape of the next barrier to keep moving.

pages.title: Rooms Hidden Numbers
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Find the digits one through ten in Rooms Hidden Numbers. Search each of six indoor scenes before the timer expires. Select carefully because repeated clicks on empty spots reduce the time available for the remaining numbers.

pages.title: Hill Tracks Jeep Driving Game
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Drive a four-wheel-drive vehicle over mountain terrain in Hill Tracks Jeep Driving Game. Adjust the approach to steep slopes and narrow bends so the Jeep can keep moving. Follow the rough track toward the next destination.

pages.title: Arkadium's Mahjong Remix
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Connect matching uncovered tiles in Arkadium's Mahjong Remix. A pair needs a clear route made from at most three straight lines, so look around the other pieces before selecting it. Use the spaces left by removals to reach the remaining matches.

pages.title: Rampage Road
pages.creator: Hammerplay Studios
pages.description: Battle from an armed car in Rampage Road. Dodge or destroy traffic and other obstacles while firing at the vehicles attacking you. Pick up stronger weapons along the road and try to outlast the next pursuit.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe Stone Age
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Place wooden or stone marks on a grid in Tic Tac Toe Stone Age. Build a straight line before the opponent does and block their winning move when necessary. Share the board with a friend for a quick turn-based match.

pages.title: Sweet Match 3
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Match three or more same-colored jellies in Sweet Match 3. Focus on the current level's goal and make combinations that leave another useful move. Unlock boosters and use them when a crowded board needs clearing.

pages.title: Highway GT Speed Car Racer Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Weave past cars and trucks in Highway GT Speed Car Racer Game. Try one-way, two-way or multiplayer driving modes and look for clear lanes as speed rises. Keep the car under control while working toward a longer run.

pages.title: Water The Plant
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Create a route from the water supply to thirsty trees in Water The Plant. Look at the barriers and channels before adjusting the path. Bring the flow to the target so the plant receives enough water to finish the puzzle.

pages.title: Dangerous Helicopter Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Assemble twelve aircraft pictures in Dangerous Helicopter Jigsaw. Choose easy, medium or hard layouts with 25, 49 or 100 pieces. Use the helicopter and background details to fit the scattered sections together.

pages.title: Ufo Smasher
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Tap visiting spacecraft in Ufo Smasher. Watch their changing vertical positions and select each target while it is within reach. Keep hitting the UFOs to raise your score.

pages.title: Infinity Battlefield Ops
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Complete combat assignments in Infinity Battlefield Ops. Move through hostile ground with military weapons and look for enemies before exposing your position. Plan an approach that lets the commando survive the next firefight.

pages.title: Anime Princess Dress Up
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Dress six illustrated royals in Anime Princess Dress Up. Choose among hairstyles, gowns, separates and accessories, then set the character against one of four backgrounds. Try different combinations to create another anime-inspired look.

pages.title: Kids Coloring Book
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Pick an outlined picture in Kids Coloring Book and fill it with the colors you want. Work on one part at a time and change the palette for another area. Complete the scene before trying the next drawing.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Halloween Special
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Shoot matching masks into groups of three in Bubble Shooter Halloween Special. Clear the cluster and use power-ups when they help reach a difficult section. Check the instructions for a bonus before activating it.

pages.title: Halloween Hit
pages.creator: GAMEE
pages.description: Throw a batarang toward matching colors in Halloween Hit. Time each release so it reaches the correct section of the target, then adjust as the setup changes. Beat bosses to keep the score climbing.

pages.title: Halloween Bubble Shooter 2019
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Aim into colored clusters in Halloween Bubble Shooter 2019. Match at least three spooky bubbles to burst them and make room for the next shot. Use the opened gaps to reach pieces farther inside the board.

pages.title: Two Ball 3D
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Guide a rolling ball over cube-built roads in Two Ball 3D. Collect diamonds to buy bonuses and steer clear of the track's edges. Try a solo run or use separate controls to race with a second player.

pages.title: Ambulance Rescue Driver Simulator 2018
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Reach accident scenes in Ambulance Rescue Driver Simulator 2018 and bring injured people to the hospital. Sound the siren while navigating traffic and choose a route that gets the ambulance there quickly. Complete the rescue before moving to the next call.

pages.title: Baby Hazel First Rain
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help a frightened toddler enjoy the weather in Baby Hazel First Rain. Comfort Hazel when thunder starts, then join her friend and Bunny for activities in the garden. Discover the creatures that come out in the rain.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Kitchen Time
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Prepare a first meal with a young cook in Baby Hazel Kitchen Time. Shop for ingredients and utensils, then help Hazel use them in the kitchen. Set the table once the food is ready and join the finished meal.

pages.title: Offroad Bicycle
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Ride through rough courses in Offroad Bicycle. Use WASD to steer and keep the bike aligned as the ground changes. Finish the current level before taking on the next off-road layout.

pages.title: Balloon Pop
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Tap balloons as they appear in Balloon Pop. Keep selecting new targets across the screen and try to maintain an uninterrupted collection. Continue the endless round to build a better total.

pages.title: Destroy It
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Break electronic gadgets in Destroy It. Keep clicking or tapping the current device until it is smashed, then unlock another object. Work through the collection to see how each one breaks apart.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe Blackboard
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Mark squares to form a line in Tic Tac Toe Blackboard. Play against the computer or share a board with a friend, choosing a match length of three, five or ten. Block the opponent while setting up your own winning row.

pages.title: EG Fishing Rush
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Cast a hook into the water in EG Fishing Rush. Time the drop to catch fish and avoid the sharks moving among them. Keep gathering catches as the game accelerates and the timing becomes harder.

pages.title: Football Coloring Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color pictures of a familiar sport in Football Coloring Time. Choose a scene and use the brush and palette to fill its outlines. Try different clothing or background colors as you make the image your own.

pages.title: Perfect Hit
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Guide a ball along a winding route in Perfect Hit. Steer around obstacles and keep watching where the next part of the track leads. Adjust when the balls along the course change position.

pages.title: EG Fishing Frenzy
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Catch fish and collect extra time in EG Fishing Frenzy. Watch for clocks that extend the session while gathering the sea creatures that increase the score. Keep working through the water before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Exit Car
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Slide blocked vehicles around a crowded lot in Exit Car. Move cars, buses and trailers to make a continuous route for the target vehicle. Find the exit across one hundred increasingly difficult parking puzzles.

pages.title: Circle Clock
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Match a rotating hand to the corresponding color in Circle Clock. Tap at the right moment and watch for changes in speed or direction. Keep the timing accurate to extend your score.

pages.title: Sheep Road Danger
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Guide a flock through dangerous junctions in Sheep Road Danger. Control when each sheep moves so it can find a safe route home without meeting a wolf. Protect every animal because losing one ends the attempt.

pages.title: Cricket Hero
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Time the bat's swing in Cricket Hero. Strike incoming balls while keeping clear of bombs and eggs mixed into the deliveries. Watch the next target before committing to another hit.

pages.title: Emma Foot Treatment
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help a tennis player recover in Emma Foot Treatment. Follow the prompts to care for her injured foot and cracked skin using the simulated medical tools. Complete the treatment and finish the foot's appearance afterward.

pages.title: Race Car Spot Difference
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Compare paired motorsport pictures in Race Car Spot Difference. Find eight altered details in each of eight scenes, checking both the car and the surrounding track. Finish before the one-minute limit to continue.

pages.title: Gun Builder 2
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Assemble firearms from component pieces in Gun Builder 2. Choose parts that fit the current weapon and bring them together into the completed design. Work through the available guns and explore the larger parts collection.

pages.title: Game Of Bows
pages.creator: ArtBit
pages.description: Trade arrows with other players in Game Of Bows. Judge the angle and power needed to reach a rival across the arena. Use accurate shots to win the duel and advance in the competitive archery game.

pages.title: Neon Biker
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Perform flips over glowing terrain in Neon Biker. Choose a vehicle, manage its movement through jumps and keep the landing under control. Try the endless road or work through forty separate stunt stages.

pages.title: Cute Cat Hospital
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Route sick pets to the appropriate rooms in Cute Cat Hospital. Check whether a cat needs care for an injury or another problem, then provide the requested treatment. Keep the clinic moving as more patients arrive.

pages.title: Ocean Baby Injured
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Care for a toddler after a fall in Ocean Baby Injured. Follow the on-screen tools through the simulated treatment for cuts, bruises and possible broken bones. Help the baby recover before her next island adventure.

pages.title: Soccerdown Euro Cup 2016
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Choose a national team and dribble past opponents in Soccerdown Euro Cup 2016. Collect footballs along the route and use the openings ahead to move closer to goal. Finish an attack with a well-timed shot.

pages.title: Pregnant Dotted Girl Emergency
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Treat a superhero after a fight in Pregnant Dotted Girl Emergency. Listen to her heartbeat, clean injuries and use the game's X-ray to check fractures. Complete the simulated hospital tasks so she can recover from the encounter.
